RichMind Privacy Policy

Last Updated: 10/01/2026

1. Introduction

RichMind respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information when you use our website, create an account, purchase digital products, or use our services.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect information such as your email address, account information, purchase information, and information required to provide access to purchased products and services.

3. How We Use Information

We use collected information to create and manage accounts, process purchases, deliver products, provide support, improve our services, and communicate with users regarding their accounts and orders.

4. Google Login

If you choose to sign in with Google, we may receive information provided by Google according to your authorization, such as your email address and basic profile information needed to create or access your account.

5. Payments

Payment information may be processed by third-party payment providers. RichMind does not intend to store complete payment card information.

6. Data Protection

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect user information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

7. Emails and Communications

We may send service-related emails such as account verification, purchase confirmations, and product delivery messages. Marketing emails, where offered, may include unsubscribe options.

8. Third-Party Services

RichMind may use third-party services for authentication, hosting, analytics, payments, and email delivery. These services may process information according to their own privacy policies.

9. Your Rights

You may contact RichMind regarding questions about your personal information or requests related to your account data.

10. Changes to This Policy

RichMind may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be published on this page.
